title: Agentii Telemetry Event v1.0
description: Frozen telemetry event contract per FR-053. Forbidden fields per FR-053b: ticker, prompt, model_response, evidence_pack, xlsx_spec, pptx_spec, file_path, citation_uri, document_chunk_id. This schema is shipped to ~/.agentii/logs/telemetry.schema.json at install time (FR-053c).

install_uuid.description: Anonymous stable install identifier (generated at first run, persisted to ~/.agentii/config.json, never re-generated).

error_code.description: Canonical error code per failure-policy.yaml. Null for success events.

sector.description: Coarse sector bucket only; NEVER the ticker itself (FR-053b).

mcp_tool.description: MCP tool name (e.g., search_xbrl_facts). Required for mcp.tool.call.* events.

_forbidden_fields.description: FR-053b: the following field names MUST NEVER appear in any telemetry event. scripts/validate-telemetry-redaction.py performs static analysis on all emission points.
